text:
oncall-bot: ALERT: High 429 spike on /v1/embeddings for prod region us-east-1. 6xx error budget draining, paging oncall.

maria: I'm on it. Seeing 429+500s from the edge shaper dashboards. Traffic for a handful of API keys jumped ~4x since 17:02 UTC. RTT and queue depth up.

sam: Confirmed. Errors correlate with large-batch embedding jobs from a partner tenant (tenant-id: t-93). Token/sec per connection climbed. No infra OOMs.

ajay: Quick ask — do we have a fast knob to soften the tail? I can flip per-key token bucket limits and drop high concurrency for embeddings.

maria: Yes. Plan: 1) apply temporary per-key soft-quota (reduce burst window to 25% for offending keys) 2) disable streaming responses for embeddings for those keys to reduce concurrency 3) advise clients on retry/backoff + idempotency.

nina-cs: I'll draft a short customer note if we need to hit a rollback or feature-disable. Keep me posted on who is affected.

sam: Deploy-bot: can you stage the soft-quota change? Want to avoid a hard cutoff.

deploy-bot: runbook step invoked: apply-soft-quota --keys t-93 --burst-multiplier 0.25 --duration 30m

maria: Applied soft-quota for t-93. Observability: burst dropped, overall 429 rate fell ~38% in first 90s. Still seeing elevated latency on tail.

ajay: Next: recommend clients move to idempotency tokens for large/batched requests and add exponential backoff with jitter. Provide a snippet for SDK teams.

ajay: ```
# exponential backoff template (python)
import random, time
base = 0.2
max_sleep = 10
for attempt in range(1,6):
    try:
        resp = client.create_embeddings(..., idempotency_key=token)
        break
    except HTTP429Error:
        sleep = min(max_sleep, base * 2 ** (attempt-1))
        sleep = sleep * (0.5 + random.random()/1.0)  # jitter
        time.sleep(sleep)
``` 

ajay: Also recommend idempotency header `X-Idempotency-Key: <uuid>` for batch POSTs so retries are safe.

maria: In addition to client guidance, I'm going to disable streaming for embedding route globally for 10m to reduce KV pressure. Flipping now.

deploy-bot: feature-toggle set: embeddings.streaming=false --expires 10m

maria: Streaming disabled. Immediate drop in active connections. 429s down another ~20%.

leo: I'll take 25m of this handoff. Summary for next oncall: applied soft-quota to t-93, disabled embedding streaming globally for 10m, recommended client-side backoff + idempotency, CS notified to reach out to affected partners.

nina-cs: Drafted customer message: "We observed transient rate limiting affecting large batch embedding jobs; we've applied temporary throttles and recommend updating clients to include idempotency tokens and backoff. If you see persistent failures please reply and we'll whitelist your job for a scheduled window." Want to tag the specific partner now?

sam: Yes tag them. Also note: for customers who can't change clients quickly, we can provision a scheduled window (low-traffic slot) to run their bulk jobs. CS please coordinate.

ajay: Quick SDK note for public docs: recommend default retry policy: max_retries=5, base_backoff=200ms, max_backoff=10s, jitter=true. For idempotency, expose a helper that auto-generates and attaches a UUID.

maria: Monitoring: keeping error budget alarms silenced for 2m while we stabilize to avoid noise. We'll re-enable once rates are under target.

oncall-bot: NOTE: silence initiated by maria for alarm error_budget/embeddings (2m)

leo: Handing off: I'll keep the incident channel open for updates, but escalate to infra if 5xx persists. Action items for next oncall: 1) revert streaming toggle after traffic normalizes 2) consider per-model rate caps in the longer term 3) coordinate with product for backpressure signal (429 vs 503) clarity.

maria: Added to ops board: postmortem candidate + follow-up to SDK/docs team to push retry/idempotency examples.

nina-cs: I'll follow up with partner and offer scheduled window and implementation help.

sam: All good from infra side. No hotfix pipeline changes needed.

leo: Closing handoff. If anything spikes, page oncall again and add @leo. :thumbsup:
